findings.title: Audit F6: The filing counts Party A's 03/29 proposal as one of the round-2 IOIs, and the Rounds sheet counts i

findings.detail: Party C's 10/04 reaffirmation of $11.25 is recorded as a new Bid, although nothing changed. findings.title: Audit F8: Party C's final exit is inferred from the 10/26 exclusivity, with Exit reason 'Not stated'. The fili
findings.detail: Party C's final exit is inferred from the 10/26 exclusivity, with Exit reason 'Not stated'. The filing, however, gives the target's reasons for sidelining Party C: on 10/20 it refused Party C the Q3/Q4 information because its price was lower and its closing less certain, and the 10/26 board repeated the point. Two readings are available: a reported 'Dropped by target' on 10/20 (refused the next stage), or an exit reason of 'Lower offer than rivals'. The 09/02 inferred drops of Party B and Party C likewise come after 09/01 board reasons that the filing reports.
findings.rule: E14 (Dropped by target includes refusing a participant the next stage; inferred exits take Exit reason Not stated; reported exits first); B (an exit label or reason the filing does not establish)

findings.title: Audit F01: Q9 says that if the round-3 responses are read as Informal, 'the deal has no formal bid before signi
findings.detail: Q9 says that if the round-3 responses are read as Informal, 'the deal has no formal bid before signing'. That is wrong under the rules. On 10/07/2013, during exclusivity and with its $21.25 price standing, CSC/Pamplona's counsel returned its own revised draft (markup) of the merger agreement; on 10/05 it returned a revised draft of the Pamplona commitment letter engaging definitive terms. Under E10/E11 rule 1, that returned markup establishes a Formal offer through a Bid reaffirmed row whenever the latest priced row is Informal.
findings.rule: E10 (Bid reaffirmed by returning its own markup); E11 rule 1; Part F (Questions must state what changes if answered differently)

findings.detail: The filing defines a distinct 'CSC/Pamplona final proposal', negotiated 09/21–09/23. findings.detail: The 04/05 authorization is to explore 'transactional opportunities', including a business combination with Party A. findings.title: Audit F10: #22's Note says Party B and Party C '(07/24 oral, 07/25 written) bid after it and were considered on
findings.detail: #22's Note says Party B and Party C '(07/24 oral, 07/25 written) bid after it and were considered on 07/25/2013'. Party C's written indication came 'later on July 25', after the meeting that reviewed the indications and chose the four (p. 34). Only its 07/24 oral indication can have been considered. Q4 states this correctly, so the Note contradicts Q4.
findings.rule: Part B; E8/E9 (what the target considered at the due date's next step)

evidence.quote: Later on July 25, 2013, Party C submitted a written indication of interest at an all-cash purchase price of $16.00 to $16.50 per share.

findings.proposed_change: Revise the Note: 'Due date for preliminary indications. CSC/Pamplona bid on the day; Party B (07/24 written) and Party C (07/24 oral) bid after it and were reviewed on 07/25/2013; Party C's written revision (#27) followed the meeting.'
findings.note: Development lead supported a narrow chronology correction. A separate verified revision addresses accepted corrections within its documented scope; this finding remains sourced to the raw draft. Human review is pending. See original adjudication and verification.
